# Aritro Saha Portfolio

> Portfolio, open-source software catalog, and interactive developer arcade of Aritro Saha, a Software Engineer 1 at Bristol Myers Squibb. Specializes in high-throughput data pipelines, cloud infrastructure, native macOS utilities, and full-stack web engineering.

Professional software engineer and open-source creator based in India with expertise in Python, TypeScript, Swift 6.0, Databricks, and GCP. Winner of Hack4Bengal 3.0 (Eastern India's Largest Hackathon). Contact: aritrosaha2025@gmail.com.

## Featured Projects & Open-Source Software
- [Byakugan Scan](https://www.aritro.cloud/projects/byakugan-scan.md): Instant, in-memory screen OCR, QR code, and barcode recognition utility for macOS
- [SutraKey](https://www.aritro.cloud/projects/sutrakey.md): Instant Shift+Select radial pie menu for video, audio, and clean document actions on macOS
- [OpenWorld Portfolio](https://www.aritro.cloud/projects/openworld-portfolio.md): Interactive 2.5D retro Pokémon-inspired open-world developer portfolio set in Pallet Cloud
- [Quarantine](https://www.aritro.cloud/projects/quarantine.md): Zero-dependency dead-letter queue and fault-tolerance library for Python loops
- [Structurify](https://www.aritro.cloud/projects/structurify.md): AI-powered SaaS that transforms messy spreadsheet data into a clean master schema
- [Luffy Laser Dodge](https://www.aritro.cloud/projects/luffy-laser-dodge.md): Interactive 3D reflex game dodging laser beams using actual head movements via webcam
- [GlideConnect](https://www.aritro.cloud/projects/glide-connect.md): Virtual Mouse Control using Gesture Recognition and Voice Assistant
- [PAWsitive](https://www.aritro.cloud/projects/pawsitive.md): Centralized Platform for Pet Healthcare

## Developer Arcade (Aritro Games)
- [The Arcade (Aritro Games)](https://www.aritro.cloud/play.md): Interactive browser mini-games catalog built in React 19.
- [Developer Speed Test (Arcade)](https://www.aritro.cloud/play/typing-test.md): Test your coding typing speed with this minimalist terminal-style speed test game. Features top programming keywords!
- [Data Pipeline Puzzle (Arcade)](https://www.aritro.cloud/play/data-pipeline.md): Connect the nodes to build a data pipeline without crossing lines. A logic puzzle for data science engineers.
- [Minimalist Snake (Arcade)](https://www.aritro.cloud/play/snake.md): The Python developer edition of the classic game. Collect tech stack icons on an infinite grid.
- [Sudoku (Arcade)](https://www.aritro.cloud/play/sudoku.md): Classic logic-based number placement puzzle.
- [Space Invaders (Arcade)](https://www.aritro.cloud/play/space-invaders.md): Defend the server from incoming bugs in this classic retro shooter.
- [Flappy Bird (Arcade)](https://www.aritro.cloud/play/flappy-bird.md): Navigate the bird through the pipes in this challenging arcade classic.
- [Tic Tac Toe (Arcade)](https://www.aritro.cloud/play/tictactoe.md): Play against an AI in this classic game. Can you beat the Minimax algorithm?
